plain_language.current_behaviour: Today, the order of answer options in the grouped additional-symptoms question can depend on the order the user tapped their symptoms. The same symptoms tapped in a different order can show the same options in a different sequence.
plain_language.candidate_behaviour: Candidate 1.1 always shows those options in one declared, deterministic order.
plain_language.what_approval_does_not_do: Approving the ordering rule does not approve any of the 135 wording choices and does not activate or publish candidate 1.1.

global_ordering_decision.reviewer_rationale: A stable option order provides a consistent and predictable user experience regardless of symptom-selection order and improves reproducibility, testing and documentation. Evidence establishes that the change affects display order only.
